title: The staged entrance has width 7 against the parent width 8
body:
## Summary
- Helpers 644 and 660 climb from `(429, 30)` to the length-9 dyadic frame. Each climb rank is the growth in the number of blocks, and both totals are `9 - 2 = 7`.
- The parent entrance is the one-block frame `(30)`, so its totals are `9 - 1 = 8`. Only the first rank changes, from 3 to 2.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no column replay.
